items.answer: I and II only

items.stem: Which one of the following statements about Gorbachev's reforms and the disintegration of the USSR is NOT correct?
items.answer: Gorbachev's reforms were supported by all sections of the Communist Party.

Gorbachev's reforms were supported by all sections of the Communist Party.
A coup was attempted by Communist Party hardliners in August 1991.

items.stem: What is meant by 'Warsaw Pact' in the context of the Soviet system?
items.answer: The military alliance of the Soviet bloc countries formed in 1955 to counter NATO.
items.markingKey: 1 mark: Warsaw Pact correctly explained as the military alliance of the Soviet bloc countries formed in 1955 to counter NATO.

items.answer: Both I and II

items.stem: "The Soviet economy stagnated in the 1970s and 1980s." Examine this statement with reference to the Soviet system.
items.answer: The statement is valid. Huge resources went into maintaining a nuclear and military arsenal and controlling satellite states in Eastern Europe.

items.answer: (i) a multipolar world order (ii) The Treaty of Peace, Friendship and Cooperation signed by India and the Soviet Union in August 1971. (iii) It has huge reserves of oil and natural gas.

items.answer: It split into fifteen independent countries.

items.stem:
Study the extract below and answer the questions.
"Shock therapy brought ruin to the economies and disaster to the people of the region. The old system of social welfare was systematically destroyed during shock therapy. Private ownership became the dominant pattern of ownership of property under shock therapy. Shock therapy involved a total shift to a capitalist economy, rooting out structures evolved during the Soviet period."
(i) Explain the term 'largest garage sale in history', which is related to the theme of the extract. (1)
(ii) Using the extract and your own knowledge, explain the following: A mafia emerged in many post-communist countries. (1)
(iii) A student concludes: "Russia's economy grew rapidly during shock therapy." Use your knowledge of the chapter to evaluate this conclusion. (2)
items.answer: (i) The description of the sale of valuable state-owned industries in Russia at throwaway prices during shock therapy. (ii) The state lost control during rapid privatisation and inequality grew sharply. (iii) The conclusion is wrong: Russia's GDP in 1999 was lower than in 1989.

items.stem: Which one of the following statements about consequences of the disintegration of the USSR is correct?
